scripts.dev: uv run --package portfolio-api --extra server uvicorn portfolio_api.main:app --reload --reload-dir src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.start: uv run --package portfolio-api --extra server --no-dev uvicorn portfolio_api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.check: uv run --package portfolio-api ruff check . && uv run --package portfolio-api ruff format --check .
